# Rania Saleh

Procurement manager at Meridale Clinic Group. Rania ran the commercial side of the Meridale contract with [[dana-prescott]] and owns the contract record on Meridale's side.

## Where She Matters to Engineering

Rania turned the security conversation into contract terms. The three conditions in the signed contract of 2026-01-12 (SSO by 2026-07-01, a dedicated database, a SOC 2 Type I report by 2026-09-30) were her drafting, based on [[samir-haddad]]'s review. She asked for written confirmation each time a condition was met; I sent those on 2026-06-30, 2026-08-21 and 2026-08-28.

She also asked for a subprocessor list with change notice of 30 days, which is why the [[subprocessor-list]] has a change log.

## Current Threads

- Annual price review in 2027-01; no engineering input expected beyond the Type II date.
- Any amendment for the remaining 23 clinics' rollout schedule goes through her and Dana.
